work_type_employee: Working as a W2/PAYE employee for a company registered outside the destination country
work_type_freelancer: Working as an independent contractor or freelancer with multiple clients
work_type_self_employed: Operating your own business or working as a sole proprietor
status_pass: You meet all documented requirements for this program based on current regulations
status_likely: You likely qualify but there may be nuances or borderline conditions to review
status_check_nuance: Additional factors may affect eligibility - review program details carefully
status_not_eligible: Based on your inputs, you do not meet one or more core requirements
confidence_official_law: Based on official legislation or published legal text
confidence_official_guidance: Based on government agency guidance or official announcements
confidence_post_practice: Based on reported practices from approved applications
income_requirement: Minimum monthly or annual income you must demonstrate to qualify
insurance_min: Minimum health insurance coverage amount required
local_work_cap: Maximum percentage of income that can come from local companies in the destination country
renewable: Whether the permit can be extended or renewed
dependents_allowed: Whether you can include dependents (spouse, children) on your application
application_channel: Where and how to submit your application
as_of: Date when this information was last verified
excluded_nationalities: Nationalities that are explicitly excluded or face additional restrictions
